Now I have a clear picture of the issue. The pods are receiving SIGTERM during startup before they finish loading their index shards. The liveness probe has a 30-second delay before it starts checking, but the pod is being terminated before that. This suggests the pod is being killed due to a default 30-second termination grace period expiring before the startup is complete.

Let me search for more information about startup probes being the solution:

input.query: startup probe protect slow starting containers initialization
